selection: Register screen of UK CMA merger inquiries with a first dated substantive Phase 2 disposition from 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31 inclusive. Included deals sought control of a target with customer-facing software or a digitally delivered marketplace material to the CMA's competitive assessment. The product traces cover publicly identifiable relevant lines, with at least one target line per included deal. Minorities without control transfer, equipment or infrastructure systems, and ordinary online retail channels are outside the group.
window: From anchor through its second calendar anniversary inclusive. Dated evidence can be an event date or the date of a primary record documenting it. The Smartfeed record has month precision.
unit: Named target offering or separately identifiable line of development. Multi-product deals share a decision cluster. Sales channels or tiers of the same technology are not separate unless the user-facing tools and task differ.

vmware.name: Broadcom and VMware
vmware.ownership_and_remedies: Original buyer retained the two tracked lines through the window.

avast.name: NortonLifeLock and Avast
avast.ownership_and_remedies: Closed under common ownership, later called Gen Digital.

emis.name: UnitedHealth and EMIS
emis.ownership_and_remedies: EMIS remained under Optum during follow-up.

figma.name: Adobe and Figma
figma.ownership_and_remedies: No sale to Adobe. Figma subsequently completed an IPO in the window.

outbrain.name: Taboola and Outbrain
outbrain.ownership_and_remedies: Anchor is the CMA public abandonment notice, consistent with the earlier pilot. Taboola's account appeared on 10 September and the agreement expired on 3 October. None of the two outcomes changes with those anchors.

farelogix.name: Sabre and Farelogix
farelogix.ownership_and_remedies: Accelya acquired Farelogix on 27 July 2020 and combined the portfolios in the FLX Platform by September 2021.

giphy.name: Facebook and Giphy
giphy.ownership_and_remedies: The parties were formally held separate from 9 June 2020. Meta sold Giphy to Shutterstock on 23 June 2023, outside the window. Paid Alignment was stopped at closing, before the hold-separate order.

epg.name: Bottomline and Experian Payments Gateway
epg.ownership_and_remedies: An asset sale. The CMA issued an initial enforcement order in May 2019 before clearing the deal in March 2020.

capita.name: NEC and Capita Secure Solutions and Services
capita.ownership_and_remedies: NEC retained the target lines studied here. Codan bought the divestiture businesses on 1 August 2023. These included NEC's competing ICCS line and its CARM duties software.

izettle.name: PayPal and iZettle
izettle.ownership_and_remedies: CMA cleared the completed deal in June 2019 after initial enforcement restrictions.

quidco.name: TopCashback and Quidco
quidco.ownership_and_remedies: MoneySuperMarket acquired Quidco on 1 November 2021, outside the two-year window.

clearscore.name: Experian and ClearScore
clearscore.ownership_and_remedies: ClearScore continued operating separately from Experian.

gbst.name: FNZ and GBST
gbst.ownership_and_remedies: The deployment was observed under an interim order while FNZ held GBST. Divestiture to Anchorage closed 22 December 2021, after the two-year window.

activision.name: Microsoft and Activision Blizzard
activision.ownership_and_remedies: The CMA blocked the original transaction. The same buyer acquired the company under a revised transaction, with cloud rights outside the EEA transferred to Ubisoft. This is one transaction family with a restructured close.

stubhub.name: viagogo and StubHub
stubhub.ownership_and_remedies: Interim restrictions applied. The UK-facing international business was divested to Digital Fuel in September 2021, during follow-up.

tmgroup.name: Dye & Durham and TM Group
tmgroup.ownership_and_remedies: The CMA required separation and sale. Aurelius acquired TM Group on 3 August 2023, shortly after follow-up ended.

quantile.name: London Stock Exchange Group and Quantile
quantile.ownership_and_remedies: Quantile continued as part of LSEG Post Trade.

smartbox.name: Tobii and Smartbox Assistive Technology
smartbox.ownership_and_remedies: The deal closed and was subject to interim constraints. The CMA required divestiture. CareTech bought Smartbox on 6 October 2020, just beyond follow-up.

awal.name: Sony Music and Kobalt's AWAL and neighbouring rights businesses
awal.ownership_and_remedies: Sony retained AWAL. An interim enforcement order was in place before clearance.

cengage.name: McGraw-Hill and Cengage
cengage.ownership_and_remedies: The merger agreement was terminated. Cengage offered the product during follow-up.

euroauctions.name: Ritchie Bros. and Euro Auctions
euroauctions.ownership_and_remedies: Ritchie Bros. announced it was discontinuing the acquisition. Euro Auctions continued operating.

seedrs.name: Crowdcube and Seedrs
seedrs.ownership_and_remedies: The Crowdcube deal was abandoned. Republic completed its subsequent purchase of Seedrs during follow-up.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA examined VMware virtualisation and Broadcom hardware as complements. Its separate horizontal software concerns do not establish overlap for vSphere.
projects.evidence: vSphere Foundation 9.0 became available. Broadcom separately ended new perpetual licences in December 2023.
projects.path: Product family continued in a changed licensing and packaging structure.

projects.overlap_reason: VMware and Symantec sold enterprise endpoint protection before the deal. This is a product-level functional match, corroborated by the CMA's broader security-software finding.
projects.evidence: Broadcom's developer portal documented new customer-facing configuration in Endpoint Standard.
projects.path: Carbon Black line shipped under the common owner.

projects.overlap_reason: Avast and Norton supplied consumer endpoint protection. Free and paid tiers are treated as one product line.
projects.evidence: Version 24.2 shipped with a firewall in new free installations and separate installers.
projects.path: Avast-branded product shipped under Gen.

projects.overlap_reason: CMA observed overlapping consumer VPN products. Avast named SecureLine in its pre-close results.
projects.evidence: Avast's iOS release history dates several maintenance updates to the window. The same version history shows device pairing before closing. Avast's regulatory filing reports a pre-close WireGuard beta and the dated post-close user reports do not date a distinct new rollout.
projects.path: Maintenance verified under common ownership. A new capability or rollout remains unverified.
projects.review_note: Established in-window maintenance. The shipment endpoint stays unknown.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA treated EMIS Web as an input and interoperability point for other clinical software and population health services.
projects.evidence: A procurement notice confirmed 42 practices already used EMIS Web and described a planned migration. It did not verify completion of that migration.
projects.path: Existing customer use documented.

projects.overlap_reason: Figma Design and Adobe XD supplied all-in-one screen design. The CMA reviewed XD's reduced investment separately.
projects.evidence: Figma's Help Center dates introduction of Grid auto layout to May 2025. Its 7 May Config announcement described the incoming rollout, so the ledger uses month precision for availability.
projects.path: Target remained separate from Adobe.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA identified FigJam as an online whiteboard. The primary same-task overlap documented for the selected target lines concerns Figma Design and XD.
projects.evidence: Figma documented availability of new image editing tools in FigJam.
projects.path: Target remained separate from Adobe.

projects.overlap_reason: Both firms supplied publisher-facing content recommendations. Outbrain's 2018 Smartfeed was the relevant publisher product.
projects.evidence: An Outbrain case report archived under January 2022 describes deployment of Smartlogic on Smartfeed at Prisma Media. Date precision is the archive month.
projects.path: Separate from Taboola. Publisher-facing side of a two-sided business.

projects.overlap_reason: Both companies offered advertiser-side content recommendation and display services. This is same-task supply, even where the CMA found weak competitive effects in the broader advertiser market.
projects.evidence: Release log records full availability of live campaign reporting in the advertiser product.
projects.path: Separate from Taboola. Shares infrastructure and firm with Smartfeed.

projects.product: FLX Open Connect and NDC distribution
projects.overlap_reason: The CMA identified overlap between Farelogix's distribution tools and Sabre's distribution services. Open Connect and the NDC API count once.
projects.evidence: Accelya reported completion of its customer-facing integrated FLX platform, combining the product portfolios. Its January 2022 update documents actual NDC transactions processed through FLX.
projects.path: Combined successor under a different buyer. Code uncertain in the strict lineage sensitivity.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA identified competition between the two parties' airline merchandising modules and named FLX Merchandise.
projects.evidence: Hawaiian Airlines already used the engine. Air France-KLM selected it in March 2021, but its announcement described future rollout. No completed incremental deployment or material release was confirmed for this named engine.
projects.path: Observed operating under an alternative owner.
projects.review_note: Accelya named the engine in its March 2021 Air France-KLM rollout plan. The joint Atriis and airline release dated 7 December 2022 describes a recently introduced seat bundle, too late to verify shipment by 1 May 2022.

projects.overlap_reason: Giphy sold paid branded GIF placements. The CMA identified potential competition with Facebook display advertising, especially through prospective UK expansion. Current global supply and a potential UK constraint are distinct.
projects.evidence: The CMA found the advertising service stopped at the time of the merger. The date is the legal closing date used to locate the cessation.
projects.path: The Giphy brand and core API continued. Later sale outside the window.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA analysed Giphy's GIF tools primarily as an input to social platforms and a potential foreclosure concern. This code is for the named line, irrespective of Meta's overlaps elsewhere.
projects.evidence: The Giphy developer SDK release 1.5.0 added inline previews and new contextual actions for media in the integration grid.
projects.path: Shipped while legally owned by Meta and subject to hold-separate restrictions.

projects.overlap_reason: CMA identified overlapping payment submissions software for Bacs and Faster Payments. The two payment rails share one gateway and count once.
projects.evidence: CMA final report identifies EPG as a maintained gateway and examines the service to existing customers. The checked records do not pin down a new post-close release.
projects.path: EPG business acquired by Bottomline. Product development endpoint unresolved.
projects.review_note: The CMA's February 2020 derogation concerns supplying hardware security modules to existing EPG customers. Neither that authority nor the final report verifies a product launch or completed rollout.

projects.overlap_reason: SSS and NEC supplied integrated control-room communications. NEC's original overlapping assets, including Cortex, were sold under the remedy.
projects.evidence: Thames Valley Fire Control committee records identify DS3000 in use. The proposed installation expenditure does not establish a completed new release or rollout.
projects.path: Target line retained. Competing buyer line divested during follow-up.
projects.review_note: A 2023 Merseyside plan identifies DS3000. The committee minutes confirm a technical refresh and that the new DCS connection was available for testing, with the test stage still to be completed and the national programme paused. North Wales installed its Capita ICCS in May and June 2021, before the deal. Neither record establishes a material in-window DS3000 go-live.

projects.overlap_reason: CMA named Origin and NEC CARM as competing shift and rota software. CARM was novated to Zetron after remedy implementation.
projects.evidence: Staffordshire Police disclosed that Origin's Duty Management System was implemented in November 2023, corroborating the separate procurement record.
projects.path: Target line retained. Competing buyer line divested during follow-up.
projects.review_note: Direct documentary evidence of the specific duties module going live by the end of follow-up.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA matched iZettle Reader with PayPal Here in offline payments for merchants.
projects.evidence: PayPal launched iZettle Food & Drink, a vertical extension of the point-of-sale line. The later December QR launch is outside this window.
projects.path: Target line shipped under original buyer.

projects.overlap_reason: TopCashback and Quidco both operated UK cashback sites for shoppers and retailers.
projects.evidence: Points International's filing identifies a live white-label Quidco hotel booking and cashback launch.
projects.path: Separate from TopCashback. Different buyer after window.

projects.overlap_reason: Experian and ClearScore both supplied free credit checking. Experian's separately paid service is outside this match.
projects.evidence: ClearScore launched Protect, a dark web monitoring feature for users of its existing consumer service.
projects.path: Separate from Experian.

projects.overlap_reason: Composer and FNZ supplied retail investment platform technology. The observed follow-up deployment was in the wealth line, in an undisclosed jurisdiction.
projects.evidence: GBST reported an existing investment bank client completed a material migration to the latest cloud version of Composer.
projects.path: Shipment under interim order. Composer went to Anchorage in the later divestiture.

projects.product: Call of Duty PC and console series
projects.overlap_reason: Both published PC and console games. Activision's Call of Duty and Microsoft's Halo supplied first-person shooting games. The European Commission found horizontal overlaps in game publishing; the CMA's dispositive theory concerned downstream cloud gaming.
projects.evidence: Black Ops 6 released for PC and consoles, including rival PlayStation hardware, with day-one access through certain Game Pass tiers.
projects.path: Product development under Microsoft. A distinct owner controls specified cloud licensing rights.

projects.overlap_reason: Both parties provided online secondary ticketing to UK buyers and sellers.
projects.evidence: The remedy buyer described a working marketplace. Separation, store reorganisation and changed ownership do not establish a material in-window release for this line.
projects.path: Target line under interim restrictions, subsequently divested during follow-up.

projects.overlap_reason: The CMA found both firms supplied online property search services to UK conveyancers. tmConvey is the target's online transaction workflow.
projects.evidence: TM Group and CDS reported live additions to tmConvey's digital AP1 submissions to HM Land Registry, including new submission fields and workflow options. The dated release is carried by a trade outlet.
projects.path: Target under interim restrictions, then divested after follow-up.

projects.overlap_reason: CMA examined LSEG's SwapClear as a clearing input for Quantile and rival multilateral compression suppliers.
projects.evidence: LSEG's post-trade investor presentation identifies the live offering. A 2025 LSEG statement dates the first EUR/USD SwapAgent compression to 2024 without a month, so it cannot establish launch by the November cutoff.
projects.path: Existing compression offering under LSEG.

projects.overlap_reason: CMA identified overlapping communication software used by people who cannot communicate easily through speech.
projects.evidence: Smartbox's Grid update 53 introduced redesigned PODD vocabularies and availability in Grid for iPad. A dated Smartbox demonstration documents how customers could edit those communication grids on iPad.
projects.path: Grid shipped under interim constraints. CareTech later bought the target.

projects.product: AWAL digital distribution and artist portal
projects.overlap_reason: CMA found overlap in artist and label services and assessed AWAL and Sony's The Orchard as distribution options for artists.
projects.evidence: The CMA identified an operating online intake and distribution service. The confirmed AWAL rollout into India and South Asia on 27 June 2023 was after the two-year cutoff.
projects.path: Existing distribution route continued under Sony. A dated geographic expansion falls outside follow-up.

projects.overlap_reason: Both companies sold digital materials and graded coursework tools to higher-education instructors and students. The anchor is the failed deal, and the identified product is the pre-existing Cengage Unlimited offering.
projects.evidence: Cengage launched Infuse, embedding content and auto-graded assessment in campus learning management systems. Infuse was available in the existing Unlimited subscription as well as separately.
projects.path: New courseware capability for Cengage customers after abandonment.

projects.overlap_reason: Euro Auctions supplied online machinery sales, including its Daily Marketplace. Ritchie offered online heavy equipment sales through IronPlanet and Marketplace-E.
projects.evidence: Equipment Sales, a pre-deal sales operation included in the proposed acquisition, launched an online listing and search service for the same machinery categories in March 2023. The row tracks Euro Auctions Group's online marketplace offering across channels.
projects.path: Broader group-level route to market, not a release to the specific Daily Marketplace website.

projects.overlap_reason: Both firms operated online equity crowdfunding platforms connecting private companies to investors.
projects.evidence: A contemporaneous Seedrs newsletter records its 2021 launch of the Private Deal Room. Seedrs describes early-stage, fund and pre-emption offers as live on that channel.
projects.path: New channel on the existing platform, visible before the subsequent Republic acquisition.

screening.candidate_filter: Keep a Phase 2 outcome label or a missing outcome if the public index dates intersect 2019–2023. Missing dates are treated as open bounds. Inspect the individual case record for an actual referral and first dated final merits decision or terminal cancellation. Later remedies or remittal do not move the date.
